Thanks,

- Customer impact: elevated latency and 5xxs for production calls; confirmed by your sample.

- Priyom: prepare fallback routing policy to route lower-priority requests to the regional burst lane and keep provisioned throughput dedicated for high-priority routes.
- Marissa / Vivek: notify account and prepare credits/communication.

Quick technical playbook executed (live actions, 10:03 PT):
1) Increased per-pool buffer by +25% to reduce head-of-line queueing (impact: near-immediate drop in queue depth).
2) Launched 2 additional worker groups (same model family, quantized variant) attached to RNW-FIN-07's routing set; workers currently warming and pulling model weights.
3) Enabled aggressive prefix/KV cache hits for repeated sessions from FinNova to reduce token work.
4) Applied temporary routing override: high-priority endpoint keys (FinNova-critical) pinned to warm workers; lower-priority requests diverted to regional burst lane.

Preliminary observations: p50 improved from 850ms -> ~320ms within 7 minutes of buffer increase; 5xx rate trending down but still above baseline. Warming workers expected to be fully operational in ~18-25 minutes (model weight transfer + readiness checks).

Next steps I own: monitor warm worker readiness; if warming fails to complete within 30 minutes, we will instantiate a fallback on dedicated spare capacity in us-west (manual routing, ~35 min to fully ready). I'll post updates every 10 minutes to this thread.

— Aditya
Aditya Rao
Head of Infrastructure, Redwood Inference
